notes.title: [System] About how to add songs
notes.content:
1. Go to a popular beatmap listing website
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/de3c83246ea2913d81b05c6e1192575c7fe0deaf.jpg

2. Download .osz file of your preferred beatmap
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/75a96c76a2f980ef166c394d0d0967dfa9f08e1f.jpg

3. Put the downloaded .osz file to C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\Nezphere\Envoy of Nezphere
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/81eba0083f0a98bcbd621e9e95aa2991f6c7d951.jpg

4. Open game, the beatmaps are loaded and ready to be played.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33126096/9e2bb5e4c5fedf8468f84d0065ce05bc80c851f6.png

[spoiler]Images are blurred to respect the rights of the contents' copyright owners[/spoiler]

notes.title: [July 17] Disable resolution popup & Ditch CJK ratings
notes.content:
1. Disable resolution popup so that after opening the game, VR will not stuck.
2. Ditch Chinese/Japanese character in the accuracy indicator (the titles are still in their native languages). Now using Σ for Perfect, Θ for Great, Ψ for Good, and Γ for Bad.
